title: A Comparability Protocol for Benchmarking Relational Database Access Layers in Express.js
description: Replication package for a comparability protocol for benchmarking relational database access layers in Express.js, and for the empirical study that instantiates it. The artifact contains the dual-stack benchmark harness (PostgreSQL and MySQL; native drivers, a query builder, and seven ORMs), an expected-result oracle derived from the deterministic seed specification, campaign-state and cross-engine seed-parity gates, a corrected 90-cell primary campaign and a separate 42-cell same-host validation campaign, common-SQL, capacity, matched-utilization and long-tail analyses, immutable documentation snapshots with hashes, a 63-judgement external-protocol audit with a result-blind coding form and an agreement scorer, blind human-review packets, and generators mapping every reported table and figure to its inputs. The accepted campaigns contain 2,250 and 1,050 complete run-level observations with zero timed request failures. An author-run isolated reconstruction verifies 67 of 67 archived JSON inputs and regenerates the machine-generated tables byte-for-byte without starting either database. Independent human adapter review, independent third-party reproduction, and cross-host replication are not claimed. Per-release changes are recorded in the repository history and the tagged release notes rather than restated here, so this description does not go stale.
